title: Improved Geometric Configuration for the Bladder Cancer BCG-Based Immunotherapy Treatment Model
short_title: Improved Bladder Geometry for the BCG Immunotherapy Treatment Model
journal: International Symposium on Mathematical and Computational Oncology
abstract: We present an extension to the model proposed by Lazebnik et al. (2021) by improving the approximation of the bladder’s geometry from sphere-ring to ellipsoid-ring [2]. We show the differences between the models on the clinical results and their influence on the optimal treatment protocol.
summary: We extend an earlier model of BCG-based immunotherapy for bladder cancer, proposed by Lazebnik et al. (2021), by approximating the bladder's shape as an ellipsoid ring instead of a sphere ring. We show how the original and extended models differ in their clinical results and how the change influences the optimal treatment protocol.
key_findings: The approximation of the bladder's geometry is improved from a sphere-ring to an ellipsoid-ring.
We show differences between the models in clinical results and in their influence on the optimal treatment protocol.
